theme.description: Clean, engineering-grade interface inspired by Linear and Primavera P6. High density, low noise, professional tool.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and moderate scale. Maximum text-4xl for main headings to save space.

body.usage: Use for UI elements, labels, and general body copy.

data_grid.usage: MANDATORY for all numerical data, tabular data, WBS codes, and dates to ensure vertical alignment.

rules: Use strict grayscale for structural UI.
Gantt colors (Blue/Red/Orange) should be highly saturated to stand out against the monochrome interface.

layouts.core_structure: Split-view layout. Highly modular, resizable panels.

workspace.split_strategy: Horizontal split (Data Grid on top, Gantt on bottom) or Vertical split (Grid on left, Gantt on right). MUST be resizable using a drag handle.
workspace.ai_drawer: Right-side floating drawer or collapsible panel for AI Chat Refinement.

layouts.spacing: High Density Grid (Mode B). Compact spacing (p-1 to p-4) in the grid and timeline to maximize visible data. Strict alignment.
layouts.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Data tables and panels should use 1px subtle borders (border-border/40). No shadows or soft UI. Flat solid backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts like the resizable split-pane.
Use Shadcn UI for standard interactive components (Dropdowns, Tabs, Inputs, Checkboxes, Dialogs, Selects).
Use Shadcn Table or TanStack Table for the Editable Data Grid. It MUST support dense spreadsheet-style layout.
Gantt Chart: Build an interactive SVG or Canvas Gantt Chart. Standard bars in blue, critical path in red, milestones as diamonds.
Never use native <input> or <select>. Always use Shadcn components.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions.
DO NOT use transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it (e.g., Dropdown).

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes for input fields and cards. Sharp or slightly rounded edges (max rounded-sm or 4px).
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimal. Focus on performance. Hover states for table rows (slight background tint). Smooth transitions for the AI right drawer.

image_urls.description: Abstract black and white image of a modern architectural grid pattern. Perfect for a clean, engineering-grade Auth screen background.
Modern architecture grid abstract. Use as a subtle placeholder or empty state graphic for the dashboard.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Normal text min 4.5:1, Large text min 3:1.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='create-project-button').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize performance and density over flashy animations for this professional tool.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Use specific transitions.
Never center align the app container. Left-align dense data for readability.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for crisp, professional iconography.
Ensure dark mode and light mode are supported completely, avoiding unreadable dark text on dark backgrounds.
